The '''Emperor's Palace''' was an [[Arena Complex]] obstacle on a [[swoopchasing]] course. The obstacle had between five to seven vertical walls made of [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] [[Concrete/Legends|concrete]], with openings allowing [[swoopchaser]]s to pass through them. None of the openings were aligned, forcing the rider to pass though one and then decelerate or risking crashing into the next wall. Using thrusters, the rider would have to maneuver their [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] to pass through the next opening.<ref name="BSS" />
